scripts.install:codex: if [ -f "$HOME/.codex/skills/.system/plugin-creator/scripts/update_plugin_cachebuster.py" ] && [ -x "/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/plugins/better-response" && rsync --archive --delete dist/ "$HOME/plugins/better-response/" && python3 "$HOME/.codex/skills/.system/plugin-creator/scripts/update_plugin_cachebuster.py" "$HOME/plugins/better-response" && /Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex plugin add better-response@personal && echo "Refreshed Better Response in Codex's personal marketplace."; else echo "Codex local plugin tools not found; skipped Codex refresh."; fi
scripts.install:cursor: if [ -d "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/better-response" && rsync --archive --delete dist/ "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/better-response/" && echo "Synced Better Response to Cursor's local plugins."; else echo "Cursor local plugin directory not found; skipped Cursor sync."; fi
